# IM Consulting Services
> Independent placement agent for asset managers entering the Swiss institutional market.

## About
IM Consulting Services SA is a Geneva-based third-party marketing firm (BDaaS).
We provide direct access to 1,067 qualified Swiss institutional investors across 8 segments and 4 regions.
FinSA Art. 28 — Registered Client Advisor. UID: CHE-254.458.022.
Registered office: Rue de la Cité 1, 1204 Geneva, Switzerland.

## Services
- Third-party marketing and placement agent for UCITS, alternative, private markets and long only strategies
- Multi-segment Swiss institutional distribution: pension funds, private banks, IFAs, family offices, insurers, cantonal banks
- Outsourced distribution model (BDaaS) with contractual activity guarantee
- Max 3 mandates simultaneously — dedicated focus and weekly CRM reporting

## Key Data
- 1,067 Swiss organisations covered
- 8,865 named decision-makers
- 8 investor segments
- 4 Swiss regions (Zurich, Geneva, Basel, Lugano)
- Case study: ~CHF 40M Net New Capital raised in 10 months
